in_marathi.name: Virbhadra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Fearless, Brahma's dreadful form
in_marathi.long_meaning: Virbhadra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Virbhadra is the fearsome form of Lord Shiva, believed to have appeared to destroy a demon. The name signifies fearlessness and is derived from the Sanskrit words 'vir' (fearless) and 'bhadra' (kind or prosperous).

vedic_reference.note: Virbhadra is the name of a king in the Mahabharata who was a powerful warrior and the father of Bhishma Pitamaha. He was a descendant of the lunar dynasty and ruled over the kingdom of Hastinapur. Virbhadra is also known as Vibhishana and is considered to be an incarnation of Lord Vishnu.
